title: Add a walk-in to the queue
summary: Check in a new or existing client with their requested service and preferred staff.

sections.title: Before check-in
sections.body: Open **Walk-in queue** and choose the location. You need walk-in management access and an eligible active service at that branch. A queue entry records a waiting client; it does not reserve a service time or record money.

sections.title: Add the client
sections.body:
1. Select **Add walk-in**.
2. Choose an existing client and use **Find a client**, or choose a new client.
3. For a new client, enter required **Client name** and **Mobile number**. **Email (optional)** can be added under the additional details.
4. Select **Requested service** and, if wanted, **Preferred staff**.
5. Check **Arrival time**. Add **Visit note (optional)** only when your role permits it.
6. Select **Add to queue**.
7. Confirm the client is in the waiting list at the intended location.

Existing-client selection reuses that person’s profile. If a saved mobile is invalid, correct it through the authorized client-profile workflow before adding the walk-in.

sections.title: Explain the waiting estimate
sections.body:
The displayed waiting range is an estimate based on the queue, configured staff and other commitments. It is not an appointment, a promise or a reserved slot. A preferred staff member can make one client’s wait longer while another person starts sooner.

If saving is interrupted, refresh the queue and check for the client before adding them again. Contacts and notes are hidden when your role does not allow them.
